title: Garage Door Replacement quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install a new B&D Panelift Icon Sectional Garage Door for Mrs. Henderson at 14 Gumleaf Crescent, Balmain, NSW. The new door will be a double width (approx. 5.2m wide x 2.2m high) in Colorbond Monument colour with a Woodgrain finish. This includes removal and disposal of the existing old double roller door, supply and installation of a B&D Controll-A-Door Power Drive motor, two (2) Tri-Tran+ Premium remote controls, one (1) wireless wall-mount button, full perimeter weather seals, and safety beam sensors.
workingDetail: Garage door (roller or sectional), Door motor / opener unit, Remote controls (x2), Wall-mount button
